solves: Gathers, in a single line, the actions that apply to one area of the screen — the checked items, the page or the content being edited — and shows the applied filters in a strip below the page bar.
use_when: Bulk: the person checked items and will act on all of them at once.
Page: at the top of a list or table, to search, filter and create.
Tools: content being edited, with actions that apply to it.
Floating: the selection is in a large area and the top bar goes out of view.
Applied filters: the person filtered the list and needs to see each filter and take them away one by one or all at once.
do_not_use_when: For a single action: use nph-button where it belongs.
To hold the actions that do not fit: that is nph-dropdown-menu, opened by More.
To move between pages: the pagination is a sibling piece and stays outside the bar.
For a vertical bar: there is none.

type.constraint: The Figma property `tipo`: bulk (`em massa`), page (`página`), tools (`ferramentas`), floating (`flutuante`) or applied-filters (`filtros aplicados`). It picks the background, the border and the layout. Any other value draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

size.constraint: The Figma property `tamanho`: compact, default or large. The bar has no height of its own: it writes size on every direct child that has one — nph-button, nph-togglebutton, nph-toggle-group and nph-input — so they are 28, 36 or 44 px high, and a size set on such a child is overwritten. nph-chip, which has two sizes, takes compact in the compact bar and default in the other two. Any other value draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

label.constraint: The name of the area, such as Table actions. It becomes the aria-label of the host, which is the role toolbar (the role group in applied-filters). A name the consumer puts on the host with aria-label or aria-labelledby also counts. Without any name, the bar draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

count-text.constraint: The Figma text `contagem`, "2 of 6 selected", already localized by the consuming application. The bar draws it after the checkbox, in text/label-md, with toolbar/bulk-count-foreground or toolbar/floating-count-foreground. Only in bulk and floating; in the other types it is not drawn and warns in development.

trigger.constraint: applied-filters only: the id of the button that opens the filters, looked up in the same root as the bar, as the for of nph-tooltip. The focus goes there when no chip is left. Empty, it warns in development.

removed-text.constraint: applied-filters only: the sentence a status region announces after a chip leaves by its X, with {text} for the text of the chip, already localized, such as "Filter removed: {text}". Empty, it warns in development and nothing is announced.

cleared-text.constraint: applied-filters only: the sentence the status region announces after the clear button empties the strip, already localized, such as "All filters removed" (pending decision D-4).

slot.constraint: The start of the bar: in bulk, the clear button after the count; in page, the search (nph-input) and the filter; in tools, groups of icon-only nph-button. In applied-filters, the removable nph-chip children and one nph-button, Clear filters, after the last chip. The pieces go in as direct children.

checkbox.constraint: bulk only: one nph-checkbox, indeterminate, before the count (the Figma boolean `caixa de seleção`). Leave it empty when the table already has the checkbox in its header.

center.constraint: One nph-toggle-group in the middle of the bar, to choose the view or turn on a mode (the Figma boolean `centro`). The zone shows only with content.

end.constraint: The actions on the right: nph-button in ghost, the main action in primary solid, the destructive action in danger ghost in a group of its own after an nph-separator, then More and Close last.

type.choose_when: bulk when items are checked; page at the top of a list or table; tools for content being edited; floating near a selection in a large area; applied-filters below the page bar, when filters are applied.
do_not_combine_with: the center and end slots in applied-filters.

size.choose_when: compact (28 px) on a dense screen used with a mouse; default (36 px) in general; large (44 px) on a touch screen.
do_not_combine_with: compact: do not use as the main target on a touch screen.

bar.changes_for_user: The bar has no state of its own: hover, focus, disabled and loading belong to the pieces. The icon of the ghost buttons becomes solid on hover and when checked.

bulk-action-hover.changes_for_user: In the bulk bar, the hover of the secondary ghost actions uses the bar's own hover background, so it stays visible over the highlighted background (pending decision D-1).

applied-filters-empty.changes_for_user: With no chip, the strip is not shown and the page bar keeps its usual height. Clear filters shows from the first chip.

business_rules: The bar controls background, border, radius and space; each piece controls its own color, state and focus.
The bar is the source of the height: it writes size on every direct child that has one.
The actions are one Tab stop: the left and right arrows move between them, wrapping at the ends, and Home and End go to the first and the last (pending decision D-2).
The search field keeps its own Tab stop and its arrow keys (pending decision D-2).
The bar never removes a chip: the consumer takes the filter away on nph-remove and keeps the strip in the page while it is empty.
After a chip leaves by its X, the focus goes to the next chip, else to the previous one, else to trigger; after Clear filters empties the strip, to trigger.

The bar does not wrap and does not collapse by itself: on a narrow screen, the consumer drops the text of the buttons first, then sends the actions at the back to More (pending decision D-5). Only the applied filters strip wraps.

tokens.floating: toolbar/floating-background, toolbar/floating-border, toolbar/floating-count-foreground, toolbar/floating-radius and elevation/dropdown
tokens.height: from the pieces: control/height-compact, control/height-default or control/height-large

ai_hints: Pick type by the situation and size by the density of the screen; on a touch screen, use large.
Name the bar with label, after the area it acts on, such as Table actions.
Put the pieces as direct children: the default slot is the start, then slot center and slot end; the checkbox of the bulk bar goes in slot checkbox.
Use one main action, primary solid, at the end; the others in ghost, never outline.
Put the destructive action, danger ghost, in a group of its own after an nph-separator; More and Close come last.
Set size on the bar, not on its pieces.
For applied filters, keep the strip in the page, remove the chip on nph-remove, and give trigger, removed-text and cleared-text.

accessibility.semantics: The host is role toolbar, named by label; the applied filters strip is role group (pending decision D-3). The divider is decorative. The applied filters strip has a status region that announces removed-text and cleared-text.
accessibility.accessible_name: The bar is named with the area, such as Table actions. Each icon-only button has a label and its own tooltip with the same name. The X of each chip says remove-label and the text of the filter.
keyboard: Tab enters the actions once, on the last action reached; the search field is a Tab stop of its own.
The right and left arrows move to the next and the previous action, wrapping at the ends; in a right-to-left page they follow the reading direction.
Home and End go to the first and the last action.
A disabled action is skipped; a loading one is still an action.
In the applied filters strip, each X and Clear filters are Tab stops of their own, with no arrow keys.
accessibility.focus: Each piece shows its own focus, with border and halo. The bar draws no focus of its own and the host takes no focus.
accessibility.contrast: Text and icon over the bar background pass 4.5:1 and 3:1 in light and dark. In the bulk bar, the hover of the actions uses toolbar/bulk-action-background-hover so it stays visible over the highlighted background.
accessibility.color_alternative: The destructive action has a label or a trash icon besides the red. The checked item in the center changes its background and its icon becomes solid.

invalid_combinations: No name — no label, no aria-label and no aria-labelledby: the bar draws nothing.
A type that is not bulk, page, tools, floating or applied-filters — the bar draws nothing.
A size that is not compact, default or large — the bar draws nothing.
count-text outside bulk and floating — it is not drawn; the bar warns in development.
Content in the checkbox slot outside bulk, or anything but one nph-checkbox there — the bar warns in development.
More than one main action, primary solid — the bar warns in development.
A divider that opens or closes the bar — the bar warns in development.

In applied-filters: content in another slot, a child that is not a removable nph-chip or the clear nph-button, more than one button, the button before a chip, no trigger or no removed-text — the bar warns in development.

parents: the area it controls: table, list or editor

anti_patterns: An outline on the secondary actions.
Clear in text and clear in icon together.
The destructive action next to the others, without a divider.
A divider that opens or closes the bar.
Wrapping the actions in an element of your own.
Removing the applied filters strip when the last filter leaves.
